title: Grateful Dead Live at War Memorial on 1973-09-26
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Profesional v7.02 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) DSBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) D

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy show with a standout Loser and a killer second set
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear board rendering, delivering the concert’s electric vibe without distraction. Reviewers love the second set – especially the performance of “Loser” – while noting the first set is less essential, but overall the show is considered a classic dead night.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 4‑5 stars and uniformly positive about both performance and sound quality; the weighting favors the strong musical show (70%) with an excellent soundboard source (30%).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the board rendering "very nice" and note no audible flaws; the source is a repatched SBD file, suggesting careful restoration.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set highlighted as the main attraction; first set deemed less compelling but still solid.
